name: Roxey Aoreolum
source:
Self proclaimed dimension traveler who acts the role quite convincingly.

Even if she comes up as obnoxious and very stupid, she's actually quite capable should the situation require it. She loves teasing both Yano and Mane, specially the latter.

Her expressions often mismatches her feelings.
